list: the official 55 trophies, published on PlayStation Network 18 Nov 2026

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Nothing to chase on its own. It unlocks when the other 54 are done, so treat it as the finish line rather than a task.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission. Play it to the end and this is the first trophy most players pick up.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only, nothing optional needed.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The asterisks are part of the official name, exactly as PlayStation lists it.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the story in order and it arrives on its own.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story progress only, like the other chapter trophies.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the story to its end. Guides describe this as the Chapter 5 finale, but the official text only names the final mission, so finish the story and the gold pops.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Chapter 5 finale: KeenGamer trophy guide, 19 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It comes up through story progress in order.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist; no preparation outside the story is needed.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It arrives through story progress; playing the story is enough.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story progress only; it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Play the story to reach it.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory, the last of the named story-mission trophies. It comes late in the story.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. Guides describe a 35-task checklist, and this is the longest grind: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4 out of 10 for difficulty and about 200 hours in total. Clear the other categories first, then use the checklist to find what is left.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 35-task checklist: KeenGamer trophy guide, 19 Nov 2026. Difficulty and hours: PowerPyx trophy guide, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Push Square notes 397 stunts exist in total, so roughly 63 percent are needed. Stunts add up across normal driving and the stunt jumps you pass while exploring, so chase jumps instead of fast-travelling everywhere and this fills in faster.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 397 stunts in total: Push Square trophy guide, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The list counts 9 activity types; try each one and tick it off. One attempt each is enough, no wins needed.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 9 activity types: kit starter list, from Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PSNProfiles lists 42 challenges. Practice each range until the gold threshold is met rather than rushing through; a silver on one challenge means going back for it later.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 42 challenges: PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. The list counts 14 locations; win one race at each. Learn each course once before racing it for the win.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 14 locations: kit starter list, from Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as each win is a different race; repeat wins on the same race do not add to the count, so keep moving to new races.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. When and where Cal's challenge triggers is guide knowledge, not in the official description, so follow the fishing strand until Cal challenges you, then win the head-to-head.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Trigger details: Push Square / KeenGamer guides, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find any arcade machine and play one game through to its end; you do not need a high score, just a finished game.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand of side missions through to its last mission; each strand ends with its own trophy.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's side strand to its end; the trophy pops when the last mission for him is done.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's side strand through to its final mission.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear across the map as you explore; finish eight full strands, not just eight single missions.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's side strand through to its last mission.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's side strand to its final mission.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. KeenGamer counts 18 spots. This is the only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable, per PowerPyx and GTABase, and that flag is unconfirmed: planetgta6 notes no reliable missable list exists yet. Meditate at each spot as you find it, and keep a manual save before big missions.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 18 spots: KeenGamer guide, 19 Nov 2026. Possibly missable: PowerPyx / GTABase, unconfirmed; planetgta6, 19 Nov 2026: no reliable missable list yet.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal and where is guide knowledge, not in the official description; follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, then take the shot.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Animal and location: Push Square / KeenGamer guides, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; finish any three full sets. Track which sets are closest to done and hunt their missing cards last.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Check in at 100 different spots; PSN tracks the count, so the tracker here counts your progress toward 100. New places count, repeats do not.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Count tracked by PSN: PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges stack across activities, so this fills in naturally while you work the other activity trophies; check the challenges list when it slows down and pick the easiest ones left.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Alleys and parking garages help more than open roads.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the wanted level alive between shops: move fast from one shop to the next, and losing the wanted level resets the chain to zero.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter new vehicles; each new model adds to the count. Traffic variety is highest in the city, so sweep different districts rather than sticking to one road.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Count tracked by PSN: PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A crowded firefight is the place to try it, not a lone enemy.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport. The exact method is guide knowledge and not in the official description; try leaving the airport by an unscheduled route rather than a booked flight.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Method: Push Square / KeenGamer guides, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description only says Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks, so this trophy involves them, but no guide checked on 19 Nov 2026 confirms the exact method. Treat any specific method as unconfirmed until a cited guide does.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Method unconfirmed: no guide checked 19 Nov 2026 confirms it; KeenGamer notes methods for cryptic trophies are still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A clean run with no alert is what counts.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Five separate vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape. Plan the getaway before you go in; the escape is part of the trophy.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road and get away before the police close in. Armored trucks run set routes, so pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The list counts 52 areas; visit each one and the trophy pops once the map is fully covered. Use the in-game map to find the areas you have not been to yet.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 52 areas: kit starter list, from Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. The list counts 9 gangs; hit one operation per gang. Keep a note of which gangs you have done, since the operations look alike.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 9 gangs: kit starter list, from Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact bar spot and trigger are guide knowledge, not in the official description; look for a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and order a drink with the view in front of you.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Spot and trigger: Push Square / KeenGamer guides, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact showroom and method are guide knowledge, not in the official description; drive out through the showroom front rather than the door.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Showroom and method: Push Square / KeenGamer guides, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The exact trigger is guide knowledge, not in the official description; play a full game at that alley and see it through to the end.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Trigger: Push Square / KeenGamer guides, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description only says A partnership with mass appeal. No unlock condition is stated, and no guide checked on 19 Nov 2026 confirms the method. Do not trust an uncited method for this one.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Method unconfirmed: no guide checked 19 Nov 2026 confirms it; KeenGamer notes methods for cryptic trophies are still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description only says Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500, which points to repeated story choices across play, but the exact condition is not confirmed in any guide checked on 19 Nov 2026. Keep playing and making choices; do not chase a guessed method.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Count to 500: PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Method unconfirmed: no guide checked 19 Nov 2026 confirms it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description only says Second time's the charm. It points to succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide checked on 19 Nov 2026 confirms what. Treat any specific method as unconfirmed.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Method unconfirmed: no guide checked 19 Nov 2026 confirms it; KeenGamer notes methods for cryptic trophies are still being confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description only says What the hell just happened? It points to an unusual or easter-egg event, but no guide checked on 19 Nov 2026 confirms which one. Treat any specific method as unconfirmed.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Method unconfirmed: no guide checked 19 Nov 2026 confirms it; KeenGamer notes methods for cryptic trophies are still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed, so treat any specific setup as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Method still being confirmed: KeenGamer guide, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Laundered money adds up across the game; keep using your contacts to wash marked bills until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Normal spending on weapons, clothes, food and cars adds up; this fills in during a full playthrough, and big purchases late in the game close the gap fast.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. The list counts 8 garage properties; buy each one as it becomes available. Save money for them instead of spending it all on cars you already own.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. 8 garage properties: kit starter list, from Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten different vehicles you own through the app; each registration counts once per vehicle.
trophies.sources: Name, description and grade: Exophase official list, 18 Nov 2026; PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026. Guide: our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.
